status: traceability-only; no numerical shear calculation is implemented

provisions.check: one-way shear demand and critical-section location for one-way slabs
implementation_requirements: Determine the factored shear demand at the applicable critical section from the actual support/load arrangement.
Use the correct Chapter 22 concrete shear-strength model for the applicable member category.
Account for size-effect and longitudinal-reinforcement terms where required by the 2025 edition.
Check minimum shear reinforcement and its exceptions separately from nominal concrete strength.
Do not apply the simplified shallow-foundation exception to ordinary suspended slabs.

provisions.check: two-way (punching) shear at columns, concentrated loads, and reaction areas
implementation_requirements: Construct the applicable critical perimeter from support/load geometry and effective depth.
Account for openings, edges, corners, nearby supports, and overlapping perimeters where applicable.
Evaluate eccentric shear and transferred unbalanced moment when applicable.
Distinguish slabs with no shear reinforcement from permitted shear-reinforcement systems.
Check all governing critical sections and applicable maximum-strength limits.

provisions.check: strength reduction factor and material applicability
implementation_requirements: Resolve concrete type and lightweight-concrete modification factors from the governing provisions.
Apply the correct shear strength-reduction factor for the member and design situation.
Reject unsupported material/member cases rather than silently applying a default formula.

known_2025-edition_review_item: Do not reuse ACI 318-19 one-way-shear assumptions without checking the ACI 318-25 provisions. Published technical commentary notes changes to the longitudinal-reinforcement ratio treatment and a lower bound for Vc in specified cases; exact applicability and equations must be checked against the licensed Code Requirements text before implementation.

safety_gate.reason: Clause mapping is not a verified numerical implementation; the applicable licensed Code Requirements text and independent benchmark calculations are still required.

source_notes: ACI CODE-318-25, Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete and Commentary: official ACI product/portal information identifies the edition; applicable clause text must be verified from an authorized copy.

StructurePoint, ACI 318-25 Code Revisions Impact on StructurePoint Software, published 2026: secondary technical discussion of selected Chapter 22 one-way shear revisions; use as a review prompt, not as a substitute for the Code.
